title: Negative: switching the catalysis-made inhibitor on after cooperative CIPS bodies exist (t=8000) does not pinch them into daughters; the strong arm (kI=0.3, DI=0.1) fragments them briefly (9 -> 12 components) and dissolves all but one, the weak arm (kI=0.1, DI=0.02) rounds rods and rings into smaller droplets that all persist (seed 3)
summary: The test c35 proposed in 20261026T0726-c35-cips-coop-inhib-screen. world.py is c35's inhibitor world plus one option, kI_t: the inhibitor source kI*cat is off until t=kI_t (kI_t=0 is c35's world). Parameters as c35 (n=2, kc=2, De=0.1, chi=3, DF=2, kF=0.2, e0=0.12, d=0.0001, noise 0.02, 192^2), seed 3, inhibitor on at t=8000. Before the switch both runs are the kI=0 world: first droplet at t~2500, 9 bodies (droplets, rods, a ring) from t~4000. Strong arm (kI=0.3, DI=0.1, to t=16000): at t~8200-8300 rods and the ring break into 12 faint pieces (switch8000_s3/sheet.png), which then shrink and vanish: 8 at t=9000, 5 at 10000, 1 from 10500 to 16000; 0 persistent splits. Weak arm (kI=0.1, DI=0.02, to t=14000): rods and the ring retract into round, smaller, dimmer droplets within ~1000 t and all 9 persist unchanged to t=14000; 0 splits. Also the weak arm from t=0 (inhib_DI002_kI01/seed3): 0 bodies to t=12000, confirming c35's negative on a fresh seed for its weakest arm. So the inhibitor either kills or rounds the bodies; it never pinches a body into two that live on.

finding.operator: catalysis-made catalysis inhibitor (cat/(1+I/KI)) switched on after cooperative CIPS bodies have formed
finding.control: the same seed before the switch (identical kI=0 history to t=8000: 9 bodies) and two inhibitor strengths
finding.result: strong (kI=0.3, DI=0.1): 9 -> 12 transient fragments at t~8250, then 1 survivor by t=10500, 0 persistent splits; weak (kI=0.1, DI=0.02): 9 bodies round up and persist to t=14000, 0 splits; weak from t=0: 0 bodies to t=12000

limitations: One seed, two inhibitor strengths, KI=0.5 and dI=0.01 fixed; an intermediate strength or a slower ramp might sit between dissolution and rounding. The transient fragments of the strong arm are faint pieces that dissolve, not daughters. Lsc=3 only.
